latestAction.text: Resolution agreed to in Senate without amendment and with a preamble by Unanimous Consent.

summary.text: This resolution commends Delta State University for its 100 years of service to Mississippi and the United States. It also recognizes Delta State University for its academic, cultural, and athletic excellence.

title: A resolution commending Delta State University in Cleveland, Mississippi, for 100 years of service to the State of Mississippi and the United States.
